fields.description: Weekly issue featuring an editorial on the shooting death of Police Officer J. Franklin Beckham by Charlie Haynes and allegations of jailhouse beatings and police brutality. Includes local civic commentary on a proposed Miami Beach boardwalk in Lummus Park, the appearance of downtown waterfront lots near Bayfront Park, and Lincoln’s Birthday. Reports and opinion pieces address bank-run anxieties and banking practices, high-interest lending, utility service disputes involving Florida Power & Light, poor local streetcar conditions, enforcement of an ordinance against distributing advertising in parked automobiles, and letters to the editor on fire insurance rates and library funding, alongside regular columns and local advertisements.
